policies.name: artists_public_read
policies.using:
((status = 'published'::text) AND (identity_verified = true) AND (publishing_consent_at IS NOT NULL) AND (verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(source_reference, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM catalog_releases release
  WHERE ((release.id = 'production'::text) AND (release.dataset_kind = 'real'::text) AND (release.verified_ready = true) AND (release.verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (release.write_verified_at IS NOT NULL)))))

policies.name: artworks_public_read
policies.using:
((published = true) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['available'::text, 'in_conversation'::text, 'reserved'::text])) AND (image_authorized_at IS NOT NULL) AND (price_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (availability_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (catalog_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(source_reference, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (price > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(main_image_url, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM artists artist
  WHERE ((artist.id = artworks.artist_id) AND (artist.status = 'published'::text) AND (artist.identity_verified = true) AND (artist.publishing_consent_at IS NOT NULL) AND (artist.verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(artist.source_reference, ''::text) <> ''::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM catalog_releases release
  WHERE ((release.id = 'production'::text) AND (release.dataset_kind = 'real'::text) AND (release.verified_ready = true) AND (release.verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (release.write_verified_at IS NOT NULL)))))

policies.name: fin_approval_step_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM fin_approval_requests r
  WHERE ((r.id = fin_approval_steps.request_id) AND fin_has_role(r.organization_id))))

policies.name: fin_proposal_version_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM fin_proposals p
  WHERE ((p.id = fin_proposal_versions.proposal_id) AND (fin_has_role(p.buyer_organization_id) OR fin_has_role(p.provider_organization_id)))))

policies.name: fin_invite_read
policies.using: (fin_has_role(buyer_organization_id) OR ((provider_organization_id IS NOT NULL) AND fin_has_role(provider_organization_id)))

policies.name: fin_rfq_read
policies.using:
(fin_has_role(organization_id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM fin_rfq_invites i
  WHERE ((i.rfq_id = fin_rfqs.id) AND (i.status = 'accepted'::text) AND (i.provider_organization_id IS NOT NULL) AND fin_has_role(i.provider_organization_id)))))

policies.name: proposal_items_select_own
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM proposals proposal
  WHERE ((proposal.id = proposal_items.proposal_id) AND (proposal.user_id = auth.uid()))))
